name: run-refactor-implementation-acceptance
responsibility: Coordinate deterministic final implementation acceptance for one explicit target plan.
triggers: Explicit request matching this Skill responsibility and an existing supported input route.
non_goals: No Phase/BMAD/GDS/Chapter2-7 behavior changes, new global runtime, credential handling, deployment or implicit upstream review.
Static quality declarations grant no filesystem, subprocess, model, publication or lifecycle authority.
inputs: Explicit source/plan/request and actual prerequisite receipts described by SKILL.md; unavailable or stale required input blocks.
outputs: Existing native typed outputs and immutable source-bound evidence; never assistant-authored successful runtime receipts.
tests: Repository migration: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_package_b.py; run through the frozen native plan.
evidence: Native per-run controlled process originals and predicates under repository logs; quality JSON alone is never completion evidence.

lifecycle.owner: Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed through its existing final predicate.
lifecycle.completion_owner: Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed through its existing final predicate.

untrusted_content.owner: Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed through its existing final predicate.

filesystem.owner: Existing native controller owns repository-contained request/output roots. Listed package paths bound static inspection and explicit package-maintenance changes only; they grant no workflow write/delete permission. Runtime plans/logs retain their existing argument-bound owner checks.

subprocess.owner: Existing workflow host and command supervisor; this declaration describes only a bounded read-only startup preflight. Real execution units retain1800-second total/600-second idle limits.
subprocess.cancellation_owner: Existing host supervisor terminates the owned process tree; no replacement runner.

inputs: Existing native input contracts and required child/profile/consumer prerequisites; see the operation guide.
outputs: Native typed result or typed blocking diagnostic; preserve immutable failure sidecars.
entrypoints.preflight: From repository root, verify Python, required modules, exact target/contract and all declared prerequisites. Use the existing native CLI validation; do not install or silently skip dependencies.
entrypoints.caller_setup: Run from repository root with Python3 and required declared modules. Online callers explicitly initialize the existing caller-session transport. Optional model/child workflows retain their native authority; quality inspection does not launch them.

examples.input: Deterministic: current Q8, prepared prerequisites, action DAG, command registry and Skill-input receipts are supplied.
examples.output: Native coordinator action receipts and acceptance-passed only if the final predicate succeeds.
examples.expected_result: Q8 alone and a clean review are not Acceptance; no implicit Bootstrap launch.

examples.input: Repair: a registered action failed and an explicit source-bound successor is supplied.
examples.output: Typed repair route retaining failed action history and predecessor custody.
examples.expected_result: Identical failed reentry cannot be relabeled ready; recovery must use the native successor route.

examples.input: Stale: prepared inputs, authority or proof no longer match current candidate bytes.
examples.output: Typed stale-input block or manual pause, never acceptance-passed.
examples.expected_result: Revalidate the owning prerequisite; neither assistant text nor old proof can override it.
